name: Murray Electronics Inc.
old_description: Murray Electronics, Inc. has been designing and installing custom audio and video systems since 1996. Our team of system designers, programmers, and installers has a passion for custom electronics: audio, video, automated systems, security, surveillance, controlled lighting, and communications.
about:
Murray Electronics Inc. was founded in 1996 in Murray, Kentucky. The company began as a provider of custom audio and video system design and installation for both commercial and residential clients.

The firm designs and installs a range of custom electronics including audio, video, automated systems, security, surveillance, controlled lighting, and communications. Its process moves from consultation and design through installation to ongoing service and support. The team comprises system designers, programmers, and installers who collaborate with builders, interior designers, and general contractors. Murray Electronics offers a wide range of equipment at various price points to meet specific design needs.

Murray Electronics serves commercial customers with surveillance, security, access control, audio/video, networking, and phone systems. On the residential side, it provides home theater, home automation, whole-home audio, security, central vacuum, and custom installation services. Clients include business owners, homeowners, and construction professionals.

The company emphasizes expert advice, top‑notch equipment, and unparalleled service as its differentiators. It guarantees workmanship and continues to provide service and support long after a project is complete.
